say:1:1460426001:2.text: Hmph! How dare you touch my expensive shoes with your filthy hands?!
say:1:1460426001:2.source_cn: 哼，就是你用你那肮脏的手碰到了我尊贵的鞋子吗！

say:2:1460426002:0.text: S-Sorry, Madam! I was just trying to pick up my handkerchief...
say:2:1460426002:0.source_cn: 抱、抱歉，女士！我只是想捡我的手帕……

say:3:1460426003:1.text: A handkerchief? I highly doubt you actually use it!
say:3:1460426003:1.source_cn: 天哪，手帕！你这样的人居然也会用手帕吗？

say:4:1460426004:1.text: Ugh, my premium white silk embroidered handkerchief! It feels dirty now even though I've doused it in perfume!
say:4:1460426004:1.source_cn: 好恶心，感觉我手里的，纯白丝缎高级刺绣手帕都变脏了呢—...

say:5:1460426005:1.text: My perfume's high-end too. Too bad it's way out of your league.
say:5:1460426005:1.source_cn: 这香水也是最高级的香水哦，幸好你这种人不会用。

choice_prompt:6:1460426005.text: My perfume's high-end too. Too bad it's way out of your league.
choice_prompt:6:1460426005.source_cn: 这香水也是最高级的香水哦，幸好你这种人不会用。

say:7:1460426006:1.text: Hmph, I haven't even mentioned the embroidery master's name, the handkerchief's brand, and the silk's origins yet!
say:7:1460426006:1.source_cn: 哼，我还没有把刺绣大师的名字，手帕的品牌还有丝缎的产地...

say:8:1460426008:1.text: Ouch! Talking to people like you always gives me a headache and a stiff neck…
say:8:1460426008:1.source_cn: 和你们这些人说话，每次我的脖子和脑袋都好痛……

choice_prompt:9:1460426008.text: Ouch! Talking to people like you always gives me a headache and a stiff neck…
choice_prompt:9:1460426008.source_cn: 和你们这些人说话，每次我的脖子和脑袋都好痛……

say:10:1460426009:1.text: Hmph, I'll never lower my head just to talk to you! What if I end up breathing your air?
say:10:1460426009:1.source_cn: 哼，我怎么可能低头跟你们说话！万一呼吸了你们呼吸过的空...

say:11:1460426010:1.text: What a waste of my precious time! From now on, stay away!
say:11:1460426010:1.source_cn: 真是浪费我的宝贵时间，以后记得离我远点！

say:15:1460426011:0.text: After the arrogant noblewoman struts off, Xera walks up and helps the man to his feet.
say:15:1460426011:0.source_cn: 傲慢的贵族女士大摇大摆地离去后，席蕾上前，搀扶起了与她...

say:16:1460426012:1.text: Are you okay? She was way out of line...
say:16:1460426012:1.source_cn: 你没事吧？她也太无理取闹了……

say:17:1460426013:1.text: I-I'm fine, Sir—I mean, Madam, or should I say My Lady? Anyway, don't worry about me.
say:17:1460426013:1.source_cn: 我、我没事，我好得很，卫兵老爷，我是说，卫兵太太，不对...

say:18:1460426014:1.text: Magister, please leave me be... Just think of me as a piece of trash by the roadside...
say:18:1460426014:1.source_cn: 还有魔法师阁下，您就把我当成垃圾，丢在路边就成……
